I've replied to Dana in your DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines sets the seat count at **185 seats**. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her that 185 is still the current active count, but Amendment No. 3 raises it to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. She may want that in the QBR deck.

The figures came from the knowledge brain: the Amendment No. 1 and No. 3 contract pages and the account page. The share wouldn't open the contract file itself. Sharing the numbers is fine: Dana owns the account and is on the North team, and seat counts count as operational facts, not finance figures. I didn't include any pricing or other money terms in the reply.
